knows.statement: Oren Vey directed Nimras to Furnace Court to find Rennic Vaur.

At Furnace Court during d6/night, Nimras sees Rennic Vaur on the Glasswalk bridge about18m away with a clasped satchel, followed8m behind by a dog-sized clear glass creature with a glowing blue throat. Nimras is at the foot of the east stair; no attack or spell has yet been resolved.
Nimras has been commissioned by his former independent fellowship to find Rennic Vaur alive and recover an entrusted manuscript; his first introduction is to Oren Vey.
